deadline_is_block_timestamp.meaning: the IncreaseLiquidityParams deadline is set to block.timestamp rather than a caller-provided expiry
deadline_is_block_timestamp.checkpoint: before the liquidity-increase transaction is submitted

mev_bot_monitors_mempool.meaning: an MEV bot monitors the mempool for increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() calls
mev_bot_monitors_mempool.checkpoint: before the liquidity-increase transaction is mined

mev_profit_extracted.meaning: the MEV bot extracts value through arbitrage at the protocol's expense
mev_profit_extracted.checkpoint: after the held liquidity-increase transaction executes

assumptions: The MEV bot can hold the pending transaction until market conditions become unfavorable (claimed capability, not observed incident).
The held transaction executes with stale pricing parameters.
The owner is the only caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange().

unresolved.description: The report does not quantify the MEV profit or protocol loss, so the extraction is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome rather than a numeric value relation.

limitations: The deadline-expiry requirement is encoded via the grounded Boolean deadline_is_block_timestamp because the report states the hardcoded block.timestamp deadline but no separate caller-provided deadline value.
The impact is a claimed capability; no concrete transaction or observed MEV incident is provided.
Whether amountMin slippage bounds mitigate the stale-pricing harm is not discussed and is not formalized here.
